management_steps.details: IV infusion: 1.5 million units diluted in 100 mL sodium chloride 0.9%.
Doctor initiated. Maximal chest pain <= 6 hours. Hypotension may occur; if so, reduce rate of infusion but strive to complete in < 60 minutes.

warnings: Do not use heparin if streptokinase is given.
Streptokinase is antigenic and should not be re-administered in the period of 5 days to 2 years after 1st administration.
